pattern: にも増して（にもまして）
purpose: Describe a degree as even greater than a comparison point.
keywords: It is even quieter than usual today.
There are even more applications this year than last year.
More than anything, I am glad my family is safe.
restrictions: Often with いつも, 昨年, or 何.
mistake: The comparison is an increase in degree, not simply an additional object.

segments.role: Describe a degree as even greater than a comparison point. N + にも増して
